### ReConPlot

```{r reconplot-info}
# SECTION_DATA[["reconplot"]] (R/sections/reconplot.R): genome-wide + per-chromosome PNGs per SV/CN combination
reconplot = SECTION_DATA[["reconplot"]]
if (is.null(reconplot)) {
  section_notice("No ReConPlot figures found for this sample.")
}
```

```{r reconplot-figures, results='asis'}
# Raw HTML blocks inside markdown (tabset fences), so Pandoc leaves the base64 alone
if (!is.null(reconplot)) {
  raw_html = function(tag) cat("\n```{=html}\n", as.character(tag), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")

  rp_rel = function(p) {
    root = sub("/+$", "", normalizePath(sample_dir, mustWork = FALSE))
    full = normalizePath(p, mustWork = FALSE)
    if (startsWith(full, paste0(root, "/"))) substring(full, nchar(root) + 2L) else p
  }
  plural = function(n, one, many = paste0(one, "s")) paste(n, if (n == 1) one else many)

  full_embed = identical(as.character(embed)[1], "full")
  # Slim mode: per-chromosome figures of chromosomes with a high-impact call only, and no
  # genome-wide figure (reconplot_chromosomes() in R/sections/reconplot.R says which and why)
  sel = reconplot_chromosomes(OVERVIEW$findings, SECTION_DATA$sv$table,
                              SECTION_DATA$shatterseek$high)

  combos = reconplot$combos
  label = function(cb) if (cb %in% names(RECONPLOT_COMBO_LABELS)) RECONPLOT_COMBO_LABELS[[cb]] else cb

  cat('<p class="report-figure__caption">Copy number (total and minor allele) with SV arcs',
      'coloured by type, from ReConPlot; one figure set per SV caller / copy-number source.',
      if (!full_embed) paste(
        'Shown: the chromosomes with a high-impact call, that is a ShatterSeek chromothripsis',
        'call or an SV Padfoot rated HIGH_ONCO (always), or a tier 1–2 SV or copy-number key finding',
        'of the ticked gene list(s).'),
      '</p>\n\n')

  if (length(combos) > 1) cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
  for (cb in names(combos)) {
    x = combos[[cb]]
    if (length(combos) > 1) cat("#### ", label(cb), "\n\n", sep = "")
    chroms = x$chroms
    # reconplot/<combo>/, which holds genome_wide/ and per_chromosome/
    any_fig = if (length(chroms) > 0) chroms[[1]] else x$genome
    folder = rp_rel(dirname(dirname(any_fig)))

    if (full_embed) {
      if (!is.null(x$genome))
        raw_html(embed_png(x$genome, max_width = "100%",
                           caption = paste0(label(cb), ": genome-wide")))
      if (length(chroms) > 0)
        raw_html(tags$div(class = "rp-grid", lapply(names(chroms), function(ch)
          embed_png(chroms[[ch]], max_width = "100%", caption = paste0(label(cb), ": ", ch)))))
      next
    }

    show = names(chroms)[names(chroms) %in% sel$chrom]
    if (length(show) == 0) {
      raw_html(section_notice(if (length(chroms) == 0)
        "No per-chromosome ReConPlot figure for this combination."
        else "No chromosome has a chromothripsis call, an SV Padfoot rated HIGH_ONCO or a tier 1–2 SV or copy-number key finding in any gene list."))
    } else {
      s = sel[match(show, chrom)]
      figs = lapply(seq_along(show), function(i) {
        tags$div(class = "rp-fig",
                 `data-always` = if (s$always[i]) "1" else "0",
                 `data-panels` = s$panels[i], `data-genes` = s$genes[i],
                 hidden = if (!s$always[i]) NA,
                 embed_png(chroms[[show[i]]], max_width = "100%",
                           caption = paste0(show[i], ": ", s$reasons[i])))
      })
      raw_html(tags$div(class = "rp-grid", figs,
        tags$p(class = "rp-none table-footnote", hidden = if (any(s$always)) NA,
               "None of these chromosomes carries a finding of the ticked gene list(s); tick a list to show its chromosomes.")))
    }
    rest = length(chroms) - length(show)
    omitted = c(if (!is.null(x$genome)) "the genome-wide figure",
                if (rest > 0) plural(rest, "other per-chromosome figure"))
    if (length(omitted) > 0) {
      # One HTML string: htmltools' newlines between children would render as " ."
      raw_html(tags$p(class = "table-footnote", HTML(sprintf(
        "Not embedded: %s; see <code>%s</code>. Render with <code>--embed full</code> to include every figure.",
        paste(omitted, collapse = " and "), htmltools::htmlEscape(folder)))))
    }
  }
  if (length(combos) > 1) cat(":::\n\n")

  # List-dependent figures follow the gene-list chips, through the overview's own predicate
  # (window.keyFindings.kfRowMatches, looked up per call: key_findings.js is inlined later)
  if (!full_embed && any(!sel$always)) raw_html(tags$script(HTML('
(function () {
  function apply(s) {
    var kf = window.keyFindings;
    document.querySelectorAll(".rp-grid").forEach(function (grid) {
      var shown = 0;
      grid.querySelectorAll(".rp-fig").forEach(function (fig) {
        var on = fig.getAttribute("data-always") === "1";
        if (!on && kf && s) {
          var genes = (fig.getAttribute("data-genes") || "").split(",");
          on = kf.kfRowMatches({ gene: genes[0] || "", genes: genes, tier: 1,
                                 panels: (fig.getAttribute("data-panels") || "").split(",") }, s);
        }
        fig.hidden = !on;
        if (on) shown++;
      });
      var none = grid.querySelector(".rp-none");
      if (none) none.hidden = shown > 0;
    });
  }
  if (typeof window.registerPanelListener === "function")
    window.registerPanelListener(function (s) { apply(s); });
})();')))
}
```
